scope.target: NASA PGDA Site01 / Connecting Ridge, sampled as a 990 m x 990 m window within the earlier 1 km read-only screen.

askja_holdout.reason: Its selected reference-centred 990 m window is dominated by near-flat/equal-elevation samples. It is held out until a caldera, lava-field, or lake-margin landform AOI is selected.

completeness_policy.note: Pilot gates are operational assumptions. Data completeness describes supplied feature groups and raster-valid coverage; it does not describe direct LOLA observation support.

analysis_configuration.spatial_pattern: largest 8-connected patch of slope >=25 degrees, divided by valid slope area

weight_sensitivity.method: Baseline plus one-at-a-time +/-20% perturbation of each of the five mission weights, with weights renormalized.
weight_sensitivity.interpretation: Counts across tested scenarios are descriptive robustness checks, not probabilities or confidence levels.

limitations: All study footprints are provisional reference-centred windows, not approved geomorphic AOIs.

Site01's embedded LOLA GeoTIFF WKT has a placeholder datum, but official PGDA Product 78 documentation identifies the GeoTIFF layers as MOON_ME/DE421; no raw WKT rewrite or coordinate transformation was performed. The provider ROI shapefile frame remains unverified.

Positive LDEC support in the Site01 window is 9.235%, distinct from 100% raster-valid mask coverage. PGDA Product 78 notes that roughly 90% of 5 m polar LDEM pixels are interpolated by design because of LOLA shot spacing.
Copernicus DSM effective terrain resolution and per-pixel quality were not independently established for these windows; quality companion rasters were not retrieved.
Earth vertical reference is product-level EGM2008 documentation. Absolute cross-body elevations were not compared.
The 30 m scale, 150 m relief window, valid-neighbour fraction, weights, and tolerances are provisional pilot assumptions, not NASA or rover-manufacturer standards.
The score is 100/(1+weighted_distance): a relative ranking index, not a probability, safety assessment, or site certification.

relief_window_sensitivity.method: Recomputed the existing five-group metric calculations on the same four 30m, 33x33 sample grids, changing only the requested Local Relief window. The repository method rounds requested physical windows to an odd cell count and records actual centre-to-centre span. All other metrics, mission weights, tolerances, grid, extents, masks, and anchors were held constant.
relief_window_sensitivity.interpretation: The rank order is unchanged across the tested 60m, 120m, and 180m centre-to-centre relief windows. The score values change as expected because the Local Relief descriptor changes. Haughton remains rank 1 in all three exploratory scenarios; this is not a probability or evidence of AOI validity.
scope_limits: This tests Local Relief window sensitivity only; analysis pixel scale remains 30m.
All windows are provisional reference-centred sample windows, not approved geomorphic AOIs.
The result does not establish effective resolution or physical comparability of the sources.
No science-team approval of the default window has been made.
